//! A committed epoch instead of a clock: the file is clean and the gate
//! must still be RED, because a frozen base ages past the delete TTL and
//! the whole live suite turns into a silent pass.

fn base_s() -> i64 {
    1_700_000_000
}

fn past_window(width_s: i64) -> (i64, i64) {
    (base_s() - width_s, base_s())
}
